newsitem.title: USA: USG to build $110 mln wallboard plant.
newsitem.headline: USG to build $110 mln wallboard plant.

text.p: USG Corp said Monday its U.S. Gypsum Co subsidiary will build a $110 million plant to manufacture Sheetrock brand gypsum wallboard in Bridgeport, Ala.
The plant will replace high-cost manufacturing capacity in Plasterco, Va.
The new plant will have the capacity to produce 700 million square feet of gypsum wallboard annually.
Initially, it will employ about 160 people, but anticipated growth and related employment are expected to bring nearly 400 jobs to the area.
The plant is scheduled to begin operation in mid-1999. At that time, U.S. Gypsum plans to close its 350-million-square-foot capacity wallboard plant and gypsum mine at Plasterco, Va.
